title: Intake completeness
description: Deterministic checks for whether a Jira work item contains enough context to begin assessment.

scoreBands.label: Proceed
scoreBands.description: Required intake context is sufficiently complete for the next stage.

scoreBands.label: Hold for remediation
scoreBands.description: Some intake context exists, but open items should be addressed before proceeding.

scoreBands.label: Hold for remediation
scoreBands.description: The intake is materially incomplete and needs more context before proceeding.

checks.label: FCRM project
checks.failure: Work item is outside the FCRM project.

checks.label: Clear summary
checks.failure: Add a clear summary describing the requested change.

checks.label: Business context
checks.failure: Add business context, scope, and the intended outcome to the description.

checks.label: Issue type
checks.failure: Set an issue type before assessment begins.

checks.label: Named owner
checks.failure: Assign an accountable owner for the intake.

checks.label: Useful classification
checks.failure: Add at least one label to classify the work item.

checks.label: Initial collaboration context
checks.failure: Add at least one non-FULCRUM Jira comment capturing initial context or questions.
